en: Job 27

p.src: 1  Job again took up his parable, and said,

en: Job again took up his parable, and said,
u.src: 1  Job again took up his parable, and said,

p.src: 2  “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter

en: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter
u.src: 2  “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter

p.src: 3  (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

en: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);
u.src: 3  (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

p.src: 4  surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.

en: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.
u.src: 4  surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.

p.src: 5  Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

en: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.
u.src: 5  Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

p.src: 6  I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.

en: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.
u.src: 6  I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.

p.src: 7  “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.

en: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.
u.src: 7  “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.

p.src: 8  For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

en: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
u.src: 8  For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

p.src: 9  Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?

en: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?
u.src: 9  Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?

p.src: 10  Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?

en: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?
u.src: 10  Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?

p.src: 11  I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.

en: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.
u.src: 11  I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.

p.src: 12  Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?

en: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?
u.src: 12  Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?

p.src: 13  “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

en: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.
u.src: 13  “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

p.src: 14  If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.

en: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.
u.src: 14  If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.

p.src: 15  Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.

en: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.
u.src: 15  Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.

p.src: 16  Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;

en: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;
u.src: 16  Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;

p.src: 17  he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.

en: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.
u.src: 17  he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.

p.src: 18  He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.

en: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.
u.src: 18  He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.

p.src: 19  He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.

en: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.
u.src: 19  He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.

p.src: 20  Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.

en: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.
u.src: 20  Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.

p.src: 21  The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.

en: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.
u.src: 21  The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.

p.src: 22  For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.

en: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.
u.src: 22  For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.

p.src: 23  Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.

en: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.
u.src: 23  Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.
